items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He said you‟re working for Costello, the biggest gangster in New York.

ctx.x: La Vivan Rose. So I go… now I didn‟t know this was gangster… this is where Papa Costello… it‟s Papa Costello‟s place. So I‟m over there playing with Phil Moore, with Dorothy Danvers. We‟re playing and she was a great success, [unintelligible] and we‟re playing. I think Johnny [Unintelligible] was playing trumpet, Kenny Watt was on drums. We had a wonderful relationship.
